faq_heading: Homes near Langley Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Langley Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Langley School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Langley Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: By name: a listing shows up when its description mentions Langley Secondary. Ask Jared to watch for nearby homes that leave the school out.

faq.q: How much do homes near Langley Secondary sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 177 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,330,000, townhomes $760,000, condos $465,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Langley Secondary?
faq.a: Within 2 km of Langley Secondary the median was 27 days on the market, closing at 97.4% of the list price, with 3% of sales above the list price for the 177 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Langley Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Choices Program (0.1 km south), Langley Education Centre (0.1 km south) and Credo Christian Schools (1.3 km south-east).

How the Langley Secondary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Langley Secondary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 2 km of Langley Secondary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 177 homes sold within 2 km of Langley Secondary: 33 houses, 41 townhomes and 99 condos. The largest group was condos, at a median of $465,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Langley Secondary

12 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Langley Secondary in a straight line (7 elementary, 3 secondary, 1 other, 1 middle; 3 independent). The closest is Choices Program, 0.1 km away, and the farthest on this list is Nicomekl Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Langley Fundamental Elementary (1.4 km); the nearest independent school is Credo Christian Schools (1.3 km). Other secondary schools close by: Choices Program (0.1 km south), Langley Education Centre (0.1 km south), Whytecliff Agile Learning Centre-Langley (1.7 km west).
